decisions.statement: An entry that is no decision kind is not a decision.
A decision states a truth rather than a reason.
A decision true of every page below a domain belongs to the domain.

definition: what must be true of a page, each with the sort it is

directives.name: Move When It Turns
directives.act: Move a decision to the property that fits, or delete it, as soon as its truth changes.
directives.warrant: Nothing re-reads a decision, so one filed where it no longer belongs misleads until tested.
aids: Check the whole claim, not just the case you met.
Move it if still meant, delete it if not.
